about_the_game:
Story

Spring. Two years have passed since Tōya Akashi, now a third-year university student, formed the band “Re:sonance” together with Reika and Yukari.

Casual conversations on campus, late-night rehearsals in the basement —
every moment flows along with their music.

Anxieties. Tension. The heat of the stage.
And then, a new wall they must face.
Days spent clashing through sound and emotion.

As the performance at the upcoming school festival draws near,
the hearts of the three begin to waver and shift.

Within their calm, ordinary youth lies a quiet but undeniable passion.
A visual novel depicting the growth of three musicians through their journey together as a band.

Overview

This is a visual novel centered around band activities.
The story unfolds mainly through clicking to advance the text.
Each of the two heroines has her own individual route,
and completing all scenarios takes approximately 5–6 hours.

If you plan to stream or upload gameplay videos,
please contact us in advance.

name: Unplugged.
short_description: Intense rehearsals before the live show. Searching for inspiration for their next song. Performing on stage at the school festival. A story of youth and inner conflict told through the melodies of the band “Re:sonance.” A visual novel that captures the days they spend facing music—and themselves.
